title.narrative: Providing Shelter and Vital Non-Food Items Assistance to Internally Displaced Persons in Southern Yemen for 2021

description.narrative: Distribution of (3200) bags of emergency shelter, (10,000) bags of non-food items, (6000) tents, and distribution of (1500) transitional shelters through the organization to the beneficiaries in the targeted areas to benefit (102,900) individuals.
Meeting the emergency needs of affected displaced families and improving the living conditions of Yemeni IDPs by providing safe and dignified shelter and non-food items.

Securing Numbers bags of emergency shelter, bags of non-food items, tents, and distributing and transitional shelters through the organization and distributing them to the beneficiaries in the targeted areas.
